name: amb_body
prompt: The LAST reference image is a frame of the original video this replaces. Match its flat vector art style exactly: the same palette (crimson red, white, slate grey-blue, near-black), the same flat fills without outlines, proportions and level of detail. The same boxy ambulance seen exactly from the side, facing right, with the red cross emblem, red and white stripes, slate lower band and the word on the side. Draw it WITHOUT wheels: the two wheel arches are empty semicircle cut-outs showing transparency, and WITHOUT the roof beacon light (the roof is flat and clear). Nothing else.

name: amb_wasami_head
prompt: A vector trace of the FIRST photo reference: the same young man's head and neck, same angle, same wide-eyed open-mouthed expression, same hair shape, reproduced as a flat vector portrait made of a few flat colour layers (like a posterised vector tracing: skin base, skin shadow, cheek flush, hair black, hair highlight, eye whites, mouth). Keep his exact proportions: round broad face, full cheeks, wide jaw, small round very wide-open eyes, straight thick eyebrows, broad nose, wide mouth, heavy fringe. It must be unmistakably the same person as in the photos. Head and neck only, transparent background, no text.
_feedback: 2026-09-26 のユーザーの指摘（顔がワサミに似ていない）で、先に写真をなぞった頭を作り、ポーズの参照にする
